paths.name: framer-motion
paths.message: Use `m` instead of `motion`, inside the app-wide <LazyMotion features={domAnimation} strict> in components/providers/motion-provider.tsx. `motion` compiles in the full feature set (drag, layout, projection) and puts ~10-18 kB gzip back into first-load JS. AnimatePresence, useMotionValue, useSpring and useTransform stay imported from framer-motion as normal.
